errors.network: No connection to the server. Check your internet and try again. Nothing you entered is lost.
errors.unauthorized: This browser no longer has access to your profile. Open your restore link to get it back.
errors.invalid_input: Some of the data was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
errors.not_found: We couldn't find what you were looking for. It may have been deleted.
errors.conflict: Your profile changed in another tab at the same moment. We loaded the latest version, so repeat your last change if it's missing.
errors.rate_limited: You've reached today's limit for this action. It resets tomorrow.
errors.storage_unavailable: We couldn't save right now. Try again in a minute.
errors.ai_unavailable: The AI part is unavailable right now. Everything else works, so try this again a bit later.
errors.server_error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a minute.

profile.orphaned: We couldn't find your saved profile on this device.
profile.orphanedHint: It may be a temporary problem. Try again, or start a new profile; your progress link still works if you saved it.
profile.restoreAsk: Open the profile from this link?
profile.restoreAskHint: This browser already has a profile with progress. If you open the linked one, you can switch back to the current profile later.
profile.restoreInvalid: This restore link doesn't work. The profile may have been deleted, or the link was copied incompletely.
profile.restored: Your profile is open on this device.
profile.switchBack: Switch back to the previous profile
